title: WO lines Create and Edit enables add / edit / move parts within WO / authorize / manage part requests
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Work Order Lines Permissions
expected: All actions succeed (add/edit/move parts/authorize/manage part requests); lines persist
actual: Created WO, added a new line via New Line dialog - line persisted (Lines (1), 'ZZAUTOTEST ...' row). Authorized the line via Approve - status changed Needs Approval -> Approved and persisted. Line more_vert menu exposes Edit labor (opens functional Edit Labor dialog with technician selector + Save&Close), Request part, Add line note, Story history, Add inspection. Add + Authorize fully verified and persisted
reason: Add and Authorize completed end-to-end and persist; edit/part-request affordances present and open functional dialogs, but a persisted edit-value change, move-part-between-lines, and manage-part-request could not be driven end-to-end in the harness (needs parts on multiple lines)

expected: Line removed; WO totals update accordingly
actual: Created WO, added 2 lines; selected one, bulk-action menu offered 'Delete lines'; deleting removed it (Lines (2)->(1), only keep-me remained)

title: WO lines read-only when Create and Edit is OFF
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Work Order Lines Permissions
expected: Add Line affordance hidden; existing line fields read-only
actual: On WO Lines page: button_new_line count=0, no add-line text button, button_line_bulk_action absent, no ShopCoach builder. Lines tab present but no mutation controls. Contrast: with Lines C&E ON, New Line + bulk action render
reason: Add Line and all line-edit affordances hidden when Lines C&E OFF (FE-gated). Fresh WO had no pre-existing lines to display read-only, but no edit controls rendered

title: ShopCoach Build Lines entry point hidden for Work-Orders-View-only role
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Work Order Lines Permissions
expected: ShopCoach Build Lines entry point hidden for role without WO Lines Create & Edit
actual: With workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit OFF: no New Line button, and no ShopCoach LINE BUILDER / build-lines entry present (shopcoach entry absent). Contrast: role with Lines C&E ON shows 'AI - SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER' in New Line dialog (case 27272)
reason: ShopCoach Build Lines entry is gated by workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit; hidden when OFF. Role also had WO create (irrelevant to this gate)

title: WO lines visible whenever Work orders View is ON
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Work Order Lines Permissions
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST (workOrdersView + woFullViewMode; workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit OFF, Delete OFF) - pure view
expected: Lines visible (items/labor/parts); cannot edit; no Add line affordance
actual: In this harness a pure WO-View-only role cannot open an existing WO detail (deep-link and row-click to an existing WO consistently bounce back to /workorders for ALL roles incl. admin; only freshly-created WOs land on detail, and view-only cannot create). A fresh WO has no line items to display read-only. Confirmed separately (case 26393) that with Lines C&E OFF no add/edit affordances render
reason: Cannot display existing lines as pure view-only in harness (existing-WO detail navigation bounces; view-only cannot create a WO with lines). Needs manual verification of read-only visible lines

title: WO Lines Create & Edit allows marking a core OK/Not-OK and adding line story/history
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Work Order Lines Permissions
expected: Core OK/Not-OK control available+saves; line story/history entry adds+saves; both governed by Lines C&E
actual: With Lines C&E ON the line more_vert menu exposes 'Story history' and 'Add line note' (line story capability present). The core OK/Not-OK control did NOT appear on a normal line (no core control text) because it requires a core-bearing part that has been RECEIVED and is awaiting core inspection - that data state could not be seeded in the harness (parts add+receive flow not drivable). Story-history opened a panel (not a simple dialog) and add-note could not be completed cleanly
reason: Core inspection precondition (core-bearing part received awaiting inspection) not seedable in harness; core OK/Not-OK control not exercisable. Needs manual verification

title: Technician (default role, WO-Lines Create & Edit) can bulk-complete another tech's line via Set Line Status (SV-8042)
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Work Order Lines Permissions
role_used: n/a (requires DEFAULT Technician template role, not a custom role)
expected: Default Technician (own-data restricted) CAN bulk-complete another tech's Authorized line via Set Line Status (SV-8042 behavior)
actual: Confirmed the 'Set line status' bulk action exists in the line bulk-action menu (menu options: Set line status, Delete lines, Split work order). However the case requires the DEFAULT Technician template role assigned to the test user AND a WO line in Authorized status assigned to a DIFFERENT technician, then bulk Set Line Status -> Complete. This multi-actor stateful setup (default-template role + cross-tech line assignment + Authorized status) could not be fully constructed/driven in the harness
reason: Requires default Technician template role + a line assigned to a different tech in Authorized status; multi-actor setup not drivable in harness. Set-line-status bulk mechanism confirmed present. Needs manual verification of the SV-8042 own-data-bypass behavior
